📰 General

Fantasy Football Week 11: Analysts Release Updated Running Back Rankings for 2025 •

Analysts at FantasyPros have published their updated running back rankings ahead of Week 11 of the 2025 fantasy football season. The rankings reflect recent player performance and anticipated matchups for the upcoming games. The consensus identifies key players to target based on opportunity and potential scoring. FantasyPros also offers a free league sync tool, My Playbook, for users to manage their teams.

🌍 World

Kyiv Under Fire: Russia Launches Extensive Overnight Assault on Ukrainian Capital •

Russian forces conducted a large-scale aerial assault targeting Kyiv on Friday evening, initiating a sustained period of attacks. Ukrainian air defenses engaged numerous incoming missiles and drones, reportedly intercepting a significant number. The attacks caused damage to infrastructure and residential buildings, prompting emergency response efforts. Ukrainian officials confirmed the strikes were part of a broader campaign aimed at disrupting Ukrainian operations and infrastructure.

🦅 US

Walmart CEO Doug McMillon Announces Retirement, New Leader Named •

Doug McMillon, the CEO of Walmart, will retire in January after leading the company for nearly a decade. The announcement, made Friday, marks the end of his tenure overseeing Walmart’s transformation into a technology-focused retailer. Mark Furner has been appointed as McMillon’s successor and will assume the role starting January 14th. Walmart’s stock price reacted positively to the news, reflecting investor confidence in the company’s future direction.

💰 Business

Walmart Kicks Off Black Friday Early: Massive Savings on Electronics and Home Goods •

Walmart has begun its Black Friday sales event, offering a wide range of discounts to customers. The retailer is currently providing savings of up to 80% on various products, including electronics, kitchen appliances, and home essentials. Initial deals include discounts on televisions, laptops, and smart home devices. Shoppers can find these and other Black Friday deals both online and in Walmart stores.

💻 Technology

Activision Integrates Gen-AI Tools into Black Ops 7 Asset Creation •

Activision Blizzard has confirmed that Black Ops 7 utilizes generative AI tools to assist in the creation of in-game assets. The company revealed this integration during a Steam page disclosure, following similar implementations in Black Ops 6 and Call of Duty: Warzone. These AI tools are designed to “empower” development teams, streamlining the process of generating various assets for the game. Activision emphasizes that the technology supports the creation of the “best gaming experiences possible.”

🎭 Entertainment

Sharknado Returns: ‘Sharknado 7’ Confirmed as B-Movie Franchise Resumes •

The “Sharknado” film franchise is set to continue with the announcement of “Sharknado 7.” The series, known for its outlandish premise of sharks and waterspouts colliding, concluded with the sixth installment in 2018. Production is currently underway, aiming to deliver more of the franchise’s signature over-the-top action. Details regarding the plot and cast remain scarce at this time.

🏅 Sports

Luka Doncic Trade Sparks Lakers-Mavericks Feud: New Details Emerge •

Recent reports detail escalating tensions between the Los Angeles Lakers and the Dallas Mavericks following the February 2025 trade involving Luka Dončić. The trade, described as “shocking and time-stopping,” stemmed from a dispute between Anthony Davis and the Mavericks organization. Initial reports suggest the disagreement centered on Davis’s desire to play a larger role in the team’s offense. The situation has created significant friction and uncertainty surrounding both franchises moving forward.

🔬 Science

Scientists Discover Pilot Whales Consume Hundreds of Squid Daily – A Shocking Find •

Researchers investigated the feeding habits of short-finned pilot whales (Globicephala macrorhynchus) to determine their daily squid consumption. The study revealed that these marine mammals are capable of eating hundreds of live squid each day. Scientists observed a remarkable appetite, significantly exceeding previous estimates of their feeding behavior. This discovery highlights the substantial role pilot whales play in the marine ecosystem’s food web.

🩺 Health

Scientists Employ Detective Work to Uncover the Roots of Autoimmune Diseases •

Researchers are utilizing meticulous investigation techniques to understand the complex mechanisms behind autoimmune diseases. Scientists are examining the immune system’s misdirected attacks on the body’s own tissues. Investigations involve studying genetic predispositions and environmental triggers contributing to these conditions. The goal is to identify specific pathways that can be targeted for therapeutic intervention. This research aims to develop more effective treatments for diseases like rheumatoid arthritis and lupus.
